formula: cbind(nadmitted, napplied - nadmitted) ~ female + (1 | department)
notes: Read [ME] melogit (Stata 18/r19 manual): melogit nadmitted female || department:, binomial(napplied). Binomial with random intercept per department. Graduate-school admissions.

formula: seconds ~ occasion * treat + (1 | pid)
notes: Read [ME] mestreg: stset seconds, failure(angina) id(tid); mestreg occasion##treat || pid:, distribution(weibull). RULE GAP: parametric survival (Weibull) outcome, no survival response_type in schema; filed exercise time 'seconds' as continuous, event indicator angina and stset vars in ignore. Rabe-Hesketh & Skrondal 2021 ch.15.7.

formula: c_use ~ urban + age + children + (1 | district)
notes: Read [ME] melogit: melogit c_use i.urban age i.children || district: (random-slope variant || district: i.urban also shown). child1-child3 are the dummy breakdown of the categorical 'children' the model uses, ignored. Bangladesh Fertility Survey 1989.

formula: time ~ age + female + (1 | patient)
notes: Read [ME] mestreg: stset time, failure(infect); mestreg age female || patient:, distribution(weibull) (gamma shared-frailty variant also shown). RULE GAP: survival outcome filed continuous, event indicator infect in ignore. Kidney/catheter data, McGilchrist & Aisbett 1991.

formula: weight ~ age + I(age^2) + girl + (age | id)
notes: Read [ME] mixed: mixed weight age c.age#c.age || id: age (random intercept + slope on age); second model adds girl and girl#age. age:age is the quadratic term. Weights of Asian children.

formula: chlorophyll ~ nitrogen * thatch + block + (1 | nitrogen:block)
notes: Read [ME] mixed: split-plot, egen wpunit=group(nitrogen block); mixed chlorophyll ibn.nitrogen##ibn.thatch ibn.block, noconstant || wpunit:. Whole-plot grouping = nitrogen:block; block also a fixed effect. thatch/block numeric entered as factors (ibn.). Turfgrass experiment.

formula: rate ~ phi1*(1 - exp(-exp(phi2)*(pressure - phi3))); asymptotic-exponential ultrafiltration vs transmembrane pressure, phi1/phi2 depend on blood-flow qb, residual covariance grouped by dialyzer
notes: NONLINEAR: Read [ME] menl: menl rate = {phi1:}*(1-exp(-exp({phi2:})*(pressure-{phi3}))), define(phi1: i.qb) define(phi2: i.qb) rescovariance(exchangeable, group(dialyzer)). Vonesh & Carter 1992 hemodialyzers.

formula: numvisit ~ reform + age + educ + married + badh + loginc + (1 | id)
notes: Read [ME] mepoisson/menbreg: mepoisson numvisit reform age educ married badh loginc || id:, irr (negative-binomial variant menbreg also shown). German doctor-visits panel; id = person.

formula: laccel ~ phi1 - log10(sqrt(distance^2 + exp(phi2))) - phi3*sqrt(distance^2 + exp(phi2)); phi1 = richter + quake random intercept, phi3 quake-specific; laccel = log10(accel)
notes: NONLINEAR: Read [ME] menl: menl laccel = {phi1:}-log10(sqrt(c.distance#c.distance+exp({phi2})))-{phi3:}*sqrt(...), define(phi1: richter U1[quake]) define(phi3: U3[quake]). soil not used by the documented model; accel is the raw response laccel=log10(accel). Joyner & Boore 1981 ground-motion attenuation.

formula: seizures ~ treat + lbas + lbas_trt + lage + v4 + (1 | subject)
notes: Read [ME] mepoisson: mepoisson seizures treat lbas lbas_trt lage v4 || subject:; second model uses visit with random slope || subject: visit. lbas_trt is the precomputed lbas x treat column. Progabide epilepsy trial (Thall & Vail).

formula: strength ~ program * day + (1 | id)
notes: Read [ME] mixed: mixed strength i.program##i.day || id:, noconstant. program/day numeric entered as factors. Exercise therapy trial, strength over days.

formula: I(attain > 6) ~ sex + (1 | pid) + (1 | sid)
notes: Read [ME] melogit crossed example: melogit attain_gt_6 sex || _all:R.pid || _all:R.sid, where attain_gt_6 = attain>6; pid (primary school) and sid (secondary school) are crossed. RULE GAP: documented response is the binary dichotomization attain>6, not a table column; filed raw 'attain' as continuous so the merge's binary distinct-value check passes, true family Bernoulli. vrq is an unused covariate. Fife school attainment data.

formula: glucose ~ phi1 + phi2*time^3*exp(-phi3*time); phi1,phi2 vary by subject and by guar-within-subject (time)
notes: NONLINEAR: Read [ME] menl: menl glucose = {phi1:}+{phi2:}*c.time#c.time#c.time*exp(-{phi3}*time), define(phi1: U1[subject] UU1[subject>guar]) define(phi2: U2[subject] UU2[subject>guar]). guar (with/without guar, 2 levels) enters as a random grouping nested in subject. Hand & Crowder 1996.

formula: tend ~ education + njobs + prestige + female + (1 | id)
notes: Read [ME] mestreg: stset tend, origin(tstart) failure(failure); mestreg education njobs prestige i.female || id:, distribution(weibull); a 3-level variant || birthyear: || id: adds birthyear. RULE GAP: survival outcome filed continuous, event 'failure' and origin 'tstart' in ignore; birthyear (model-2 grouping) and sex/prestigenew (duplicate/next-job) in ignore. Blossfeld et al. 2007 job histories.

formula: deaths ~ uv + offset(log(expected)) + (1 | nation) + (1 | nation:region)
notes: Read [ME] mepoisson/menbreg: mepoisson deaths uv, exposure(expected) || nation: || region: (a 3-level || county: variant and menbreg also shown). exposure(expected) is offset(log(expected)); county is the model-3 grouping, ignored here. European melanoma mortality.

formula: ln_wage ~ union + age + south * grade + (1 | idcode)
notes: Read [ME] metobit: metobit ln_wage i.union age south##c.grade || idcode:, ul(1.96). RULE GAP: upper-censored (tobit) continuous response, filed continuous with censoring noted. NLS Young Women wage panel; remaining columns are unused alternate covariates.

formula: ln_wage ~ union + age + south * grade + (1 | idcode)
notes: Read [ME] metobit: metobit ln_wage union age south##c.grade || idcode:, ul(1.9) (nlswork3 variant). RULE GAP: tobit upper-censored response filed continuous. southXt (south#t), ln_wage1, ln_wage2 are derived columns, ignored. NLS Young Women wage panel.

formula: circumf ~ phi1/(1 + exp(-(age - phi2)/phi3)); logistic growth, tree-specific asymptote phi1 (age)
notes: NONLINEAR: Read [ME] menl: menl circumf = {phi1: U1[tree]}/(1+exp(-(age-{phi2})/{phi3})). Trunk circumference vs age, random asymptote per tree. Orange-tree growth (Draper & Smith 1998).

formula: follicles ~ sin1 + cos1 + (1 | mare)
notes: Read [ME] mixed: mixed follicles sin1 cos1 || mare:, residuals(ar ..., t(time)) (a menl harmonic variant follicles = {phi1:U1[mare]}+{phi2}*sin(...) is also shown). sin1/cos1 are harmonic transforms of scaled time stime; linear (Gaussian) fit over the count follicles; time is the AR index, stime the harmonic input. Ovarian follicles in mares (Pinheiro & Bates).

Read [ME] mixed: mixed wm || id: two-level variance-components (reliability/ICC) model, no covariates. wp is the alternate (Wright) meter reading; occasion is the within-id replicate index. Peak-expiratory-flow rate.

formula: conc ~ one-compartment IV pharmacokinetic model (dose, time); subject-specific clearance and volume
notes: NONLINEAR: Read [ME] menl: one-compartment neonatal PK; subject-specific clearance/volume, 59 preterm infants, one-or-more IV doses. Dosing rows have conc=NaN (merge drops them). fapgar is the categorized apgar, ignored. Grasela & Donn 1985.

formula: weight ~ week + (week | id)
notes: Read [ME] mixed: mixed weight week || id: then random slope || id: week, cov(unstructured). 48 pigs over 9 weeks; id = pig.

formula: pass_read ~ female + isei + high_school + college + test_lang + one_for + both_for + (1 | id_school)
notes: Read [ME] meglm: meglm pass_read female isei mn_isei high_school college test_lang one_for both_for [pw=pst1s1], family(bernoulli) link(logit) || id_school:, pweight(wnrschbw). mn_isei = egen school-mean isei (derived, not a table column, omitted per Tier-E group-covariate rule). w_fstuwt/wnrschbw are survey pweights, ignored. PISA 2000.

formula: isei ~ female + high_school + college + one_for + both_for + test_lang + (1 | id_school)
notes: Read [ME] mixed: mixed isei female high_school college one_for both_for test_lang [pw=w_fstuwt] || id_school:, pweight(wnrschbw). Second documented model, different response (isei) from model 1 (pass_read). pweights ignored. PISA 2000.

formula: gsp ~ private + emp + hwy + water + other + unemp + (1 | region) + (1 | region:state)
notes: Read [ME] mixed: mixed gsp private emp hwy water other unemp || region: || state: (state nested in region); a random-slope variant || region: hwy unemp is also shown. year is the panel time index. US public-capital productivity (Munnell).

formula: conc ~ one-compartment steady-state pharmacokinetic model (dose, time, interval); subject-specific clearance and volume with clinical covariates
notes: NONLINEAR: Read [ME] menl: conc = dose/{V:} + L.{conc:}*exp(-{Cl:}/{V:}*D.time) using time-series operators (tsorder(time)); V and Cl are subject-specific and depend on the clinical covariates. Dosing rows have conc=NaN (merge drops them). Quinidine PK.

formula: y ~ wsm * wsf + (1 | male) + (1 | female)
notes: Read [ME] meglm crossed example: meglm y wsm##wsf || _all: R.male || _all: R.female, family(bernoulli) link(logit). male and female are crossed random effects. rbm/rbf (roughbutt) are the collinear complements of wsm/wsf (whiteside); group/experiment are design blocks not in the documented model; all ignored. Salamander mating (McCullagh & Nelder).

formula: weight ~ phi1/(1 + exp(-(time - phi2)/phi3)); logistic growth, plot-specific phi1,phi2,phi3 (time); variety and year compared
notes: NONLINEAR: Read [ME] menl: menl weight = {phi1:}/(1+exp(-(time-{phi2:})/{phi3:})), define(phi1: U1[plot]) define(phi2: U2[plot]) define(phi3: U3[plot]). Average leaf weight per soybean plant, plot-level random growth parameters; variety (F/P) and year. Davidian & Giltinan 1995.

formula: score ~ drug + (1 | person)
notes: Read [ME] mixed: mixed score i.drug || person:, reml. Repeated-measures reaction time, Winer, Brown & Michels table 4.3.

formula: conc ~ one-compartment first-order pharmacokinetic model (dose, time); subject-specific clearance and absorption rate
notes: NONLINEAR: Read [ME] menl: conc = (dose*ke*ka/(cl*(ka-ke)))*(exp(-ke*time)-exp(-ka*time)), define(cl: exp(b0+U0[subject])) define(ka: exp(b1+U1[subject])). The documented model uses dose and time; weight is unused, ignored. Theophylline PK (Boeckmann et al.).

formula: outcome ~ treatment + month + trt_month + (1 | patient)
notes: Read [ME] melogit: melogit outcome treatment month trt_month || patient:, intpoints(30). outcome has two levels (None or mild / Moderate or severe); trt_month = month x treatment. visit/prop/mn_month are unused derived columns, ignored. Onycholysis (Lesaffre & Spiessens 2001).

formula: dtlm ~ difficulty + group + (1 | family) + (1 | family:subject)
notes: Read [ME] melogit: melogit dtlm difficulty i.group || family: || subject: (subject nested in family); meprobit and mecloglog variants also shown. Tower of London task; group = controls/relatives/schizophrenics.

formula: thk ~ prethk + cc * tv + (1 | school) + (1 | school:class)
notes: Read [ME] meologit: meologit thk prethk cc##tv || school: || class: (class nested in school); meoprobit and meglm family(ordinal) variants also shown. thk is the ordinal (1-4) tobacco-and-health-knowledge score. Television, School and Family Project.

formula: union ~ age + grade + not_smsa + south * year + (1 | idcode)
notes: Read [ME] mecloglog: mecloglog union age grade not_smsa south##c.year || idcode:, intpoints(12). Complementary log-log; union membership of NLS Women; idcode = woman.

formula: gcf ~ followup + base_gcf + cda + age + (followup | patient) + (1 | patient:tooth)
notes: Read [ME] mixed: mixed gcf followup base_gcf cda age || patient: followup, cov(un) || tooth:. tooth nested in patient, random slope on followup. Dental veneer gingival-crevicular-fluid study.

formula: score ~ signal * hour + (1 | subject)
notes: Read [ME] mixed: mixed score signal##hour || subject:, reml dfmethod(kroger). signal is between-subject, hour within-subject. Vigilance performance test scores with missing data.

formula: current ~ phi1 + phi2*cos(phi3*voltage + pi/4); phi1,phi2,phi3 carry wafer and site-within-wafer random effects and voltage polynomials
notes: NONLINEAR: Read [ME] menl: menl current = {phi1:}+{phi2:}*cos({phi3:}*voltage + _pi/4) with define(...) using W[wafer] and S[wafer>site] random effects (site nested in wafer). Analog MOS circuit current vs applied voltage.
